page: Microsoft Azure D128alds_v7 is a compute-optimized server powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 128 vCPUs derived from 64 physical cores with multithreading enabled, running at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The processor includes 48 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache, alongside advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16) and cryptography accelerations like AES and SHA_NI.

The server is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. For local storage, it bundles a high-capacity 7559 GB NVMe SSD, providing substantial local storage capacity. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options.

Benchmark results place this instance in the top tier (top 10%) for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance under stress-ng, as well as PassMark CPU and memory evaluations. It demonstrates exceptional memory bandwidth, reaching 12348.52 GB/sec for cached read-only small blocks and 376.33 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. The high compute density and fast local NVMe storage make it highly suitable for compute-heavy workloads, large-scale database operations, high-throughput web serving, and CPU-based LLM inference.
